frauxsearch-desc: Uses Meilisearch as MediaWiki's search backend
frauxsearch-query-invalid-encoding: The search query contains invalid text encoding. Please enter the query again.
frauxsearch-query-escaped-quote: Backslash-escaped quotation marks are not supported. Use paired double quotation marks around a phrase.
frauxsearch-query-unclosed-quote: A quoted search phrase is missing its closing quotation mark.
frauxsearch-query-empty-clause: Enter a word or phrase directly after + or -, and do not use empty quoted phrases or repeated signs.
frauxsearch-query-unsupported-operator: The search operator "$1" is not supported by FrauxSearch. Use search words, quoted phrases, -word exclusions, or namespace selection.
